By the time I noticed,
my legs and back had already surrendered. I was looking at the sky, but my back had not reached the ground.

Three seconds my brain took over this small mystery.
...Somebody was holding me up.

Hikaru.

en.html:
Push Hikaru's arms away—
Find my dropped sword—
Get away from that crystal. Run—

My whole life went into trying each one.
Not one happened.

Hikaru would not let go. Where the sword was, I could not even tell. The crystal kept coming closer.

No way out.

So the last resistance went into my eyes.

From the deepest seams of my soul I dug out hatred and threw it all at her.

Hikaru looked back.

Only kindness. Kindness only.

That was what finished my hope.

　ただ、優しいだけだった。

　その優しさに絶望した。

Entirely the wrong thing I had said.

Hikaru was the urge to destroy, given a body.
